newsitem.title: FRANCE: Ruling French Gaullists expel convicted sleaze MP.
newsitem.headline: Ruling French Gaullists expel convicted sleaze MP.

text.p: France's ruling Gaullist RPR party expelled parliamentarian Patrick Balkany from its National Assembly caucus on Wednesday after an appeal court upheld his conviction for sleaze.

Balkany was given a 15-month suspended prison sentence and fined 200,000 francs ($40,000) for using three municipal employees of the Paris suburb of Levallois-Perret, of which he was mayor, as full-time servants at his private home.
He lost his mayoral office in local elections in June 1995 but remains a member of parliament.
